theme.title: Beyond the Box Score
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many games did San Antonio win in its unbeaten March of 2014?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: an unbeaten month in March (16–0)

funFacts.text: The late-season surge continued into the start of April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a 19-game winning streak from late February to early April

funFacts.text: Dallas later stretched the Spurs to seven games in the playoff opener.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated the Dallas Mavericks in seven games in the first round

funFacts.text: San Antonio returned to the Finals to face Miami in a rematch.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: back-to-back Finals appearances, also against the Miami Heat

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant had six regular-season games of 60 or more points. How many did Wilt Chamberlain have?
questions.note: 32, more than five times Kobe's total.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain (32 times); Kobe Bryant (6 times)

funFacts.text: Chamberlain occupies a tier of his own, with many more explosive games than the next man, Kobe Bryant.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Only 10 players have scored 60 or more points on more than one occasion

funFacts.text: Several modern scorers have reached that rare milestone multiple times, including Damian Lillard and James Harden.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Damian Lillard (5 times); Michael Jordan and James Harden (4 times)

funFacts.text: Wilt also set the single-game scoring record at Hershey, Pennsylvania, rather than an NBA team's usual arena.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: at Hershey Sports Arena in Hershey, Pennsylvania

questions.prompt: How many free throws did Shaquille O'Neal attempt in Game 2 of the 2000 Finals?
questions.note: 39, an NBA record at the time. He made 18.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Shaq shot 39 free throws, making only 18, an NBA record for most free throws attempted

funFacts.text: Kobe Bryant sprained his ankle and left the game in the opening quarter, forcing the Lakers to adjust immediately.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kobe Bryant left the game in the 1st quarter due to a sprained ankle and did not return

funFacts.text: Ron Harper replaced the injured Bryant and supplied important scoring in the Lakers' victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ron Harper went in for Bryant and scored 21 points for the game

funFacts.text: A late Shaq pass became a Robert Horry layup and foul shot that protected Los Angeles's narrow lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he passed to Robert Horry who converted not only the layup, but the foul shot

questions.prompt: The 1995–96 Bulls won 33 road games. How many road games did the 2004–05 Suns win?
questions.note: 31 road wins, matching their 31–10 home record.

funFacts.text: Phoenix posted the same 31–10 record at home and on the road.
The Suns were the NBA's youngest top-seeded team since playoff seeding began in 1984, a mark later displaced by Oklahoma City.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: youngest team to earn the 1-seed since seeding began in 1984

funFacts.text: Phoenix swept the Memphis Grizzlies in the opening playoff round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the first round of the playoffs, the Suns swept the Memphis Grizzlies in four games

questions.prompt: When Larry Bird caught fire against Atlanta in March 1985, how many points did he score?
questions.context: Larry Bird · Celtics at Hawks · March 1985
questions.note: 60 points, just nine days after teammate Kevin McHale had scored 56.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird scored a career-high and franchise record 60 points in a game against the Atlanta Hawks.

funFacts.text: Kevin McHale had scored 56 only nine days earlier.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The performance came just nine days after Kevin McHale set the previous Celtics record for points in a game with 56

funFacts.text: Bird won his second straight MVP that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird was named MVP for the second consecutive season

funFacts.text: He hit a playoff career-high 43 later that spring.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird scored his playoff career-high 43 points against the Detroit Pistons
